about: A whole day of acts (Phase 2 «Folge in Akten»): the night writer's page («Le fil») and each later act an Intensif learner at the day's level plays («Le soir»; on B1 also «À côté»), each written as the night writes it: story_split.draw (planner, author, aids) in the production retry loop, the story critic reading a later act as an act and dropping it when it refuses (living_story.draft_later_act). The three days of tests/prompt_regression/contexts, read from their recaptures in sets/pages (one shape each: bottle, ensemble, ensemble). Each act is scored on the story judge's questions (app/services/season/story_judge.py) from 1 to 5, and a later act also on «new» against the day's first act. A day costs the night writer about US$0.72 (A1, A2) to 1.07 (B1) on Opus 5.5 as measured, at most about 1.73, so the weekly run writes one day, in turn by ISO week.
